notes.title: Alpha testers needed - New DevLog
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

Alpha testers needed. The development is going nicely and the game is heading towards a playable Alpha-build.

DevLog and info on participating here on Youtube:
[previewyoutube=b0zW1l6SPeY;full][/previewyoutube]
If you are interested in testing the game and giving feedback and answering the questionnaire, send me an e-mail on oatcubetester@gmail.com with the header "GAME TESTER for Generation Nova". I'll be in touch with some of you later this year.

- Oatcube
